quotes.text: One of the things that I've learned is that we're not in a technology business, we're in the people business.
quotes.speaker: Alicia King
quotes.why: Her core lesson from more than 100 ERP transitions, framed as a memorable thesis.

quotes.text: Once you make something easy, people start to believe that they can do it and once they believe that they can do it, they will adopt.
quotes.speaker: Alicia King
quotes.why: A practical explanation of how personalization drives user adoption in ERP projects.

quotes.text: I can tell you from experience, if your data is dirty and you go live, it is so much harder to fix.
quotes.speaker: Alicia King
quotes.why: Clear advice on why data migration quality must be settled before go-live.

quotes.text: It's actually a good thing to have risks on your status reports because again it's showing them that you're thinking ahead, you're mitigating risk by anticipating potential risks
quotes.speaker: Alicia King
quotes.why: Challenges the habit of hiding project risks from leadership and boards.

quotes.text: Sometimes people think if they do an ERP implementation is going to magically fix everything in their business and that's just not reality.
quotes.speaker: Alicia King
quotes.why: Sets realistic expectations about what ERP modernization can and cannot solve.

takeaways: ERP modernization succeeds through people, leadership alignment and change management, not technology alone.
Clean data, dedicated key users and transparent risk management on both the customer and partner side are prerequisites for a successful go-live.
AI in Dynamics 365, such as the supplier agent and MCP access from Teams, currently surfaces data and drafts actions under the user's role-based security rather than replacing people.
hook: Only about half of ERP implementations are deemed successful, and the reasons are rarely technical. Microsoft MVP Alicia King shares lessons from more than 100 Dynamics 365 transitions for CFOs, CIOs and project leads on alignment, data quality, global rollouts and how AI agents are changing ERP work.
